text_simplified: This text speaks about the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children, especially daughters, in the light of Islamic values. It warns against buying a car or a device merely because others have it, and emphasizes the importance of sabr (patience) in tarbiyah. It points to the necessity of protecting daughters from khalwah (seclusion) with drivers or entering shops alone. It mentions that guidance is from Allah, and urges sabr in guiding one’s children.

review_defects.arabic: يحذر من شراء سيارة أو جهاز لمجرد رؤية الآخرين له
review_defects.english: It warns against buying a car or a device merely because others have it
review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'لمجرد رؤية الآخرين له' meaning 'just so that others see it' (i.e., showing off), but the English says 'merely because others have it', changing the motive from ostentation to envy or keeping up with others' possessions.
